name: autorip-mobile
description: Cliente Android do painel AutoRIP com endpoint interno configurável

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:optimized: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleOptimized
scripts.android:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:install: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
